sections.introduction:
We are undergoing rapid change from last few years and speed of this phase of transformation is increasing very speedily. No doubt we are increasing our skills but our moral values and norms are lost. We all are experiencing drastic change in our lifestyle. Modern lifestyle has number of advantages by making everything short and easier. On the other hand this lifestyle makes us physically, mentally and socially sick. Other way modernity is excess use of electronic gadget, computers, laptops and machines. Our lifestyle is sedentary and intake of unhealthy food is rising. This unhealthy lifestyle increases the risk of overweight. As a result consequently we are leading to diabetes, various heart diseases and respiratory disorders. Let’s talk about one of cardiovascular disease in this article. 
 About Heart 
 Heart is special muscle found in human body to pump blood throughout body and it beats 70 times per minute. The size heart is just about our fist. The network of blood vessels that supply blood in the heart’s surface is called coronary arteries. 
 About Ischemic Heart Disease 

 Word ischemia means insufficient blood supply to heart. The disease may defined as condition when blood supply to heart is reduced and oxygen level is not sufficient for myocardium. Main cause of this disease is blockage in the coronary arteries. This condition may further lead to stable and unstable angina, myocardial infarction and cardiac arrest.
